exchange.sent: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester in AI, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

answer.answer:
Current vault evidence does not provide a ranked “strongest” list; it supports several opportunity areas and also warns that sales mappings are not formal configurations, customer relationships, or validated opportunities.[2][3]
### Evidence-supported opportunities
| Opportunity | Tester type | Evidence-supported opening | Supporting evidence | Main caveat |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Generative AI application user-experience testing over controlled wireless conditions | Signaling / network emulation | R&S and China Mobile demonstrated a generative AI application test solution based on the R&S CMX500 5G one-box signaling tester, with the CMX500 configuring network parameters, channel fading, latency, jitter, and RF impairments while measuring KPIs such as Time to First Token and Tokens Per Second.[49] | The vault defines Generative AI user experience testing as quantifying generative AI application end-user experience under controllable wireless network conditions using TTFT and TPS.[52] | This is PR / demonstration-level evidence, not a formal test specification, benchmark, product datasheet, or configuration guide.[54] |
| 6G / AI-enhanced radio algorithm validation | Signaling / base-station emulation | KT, Qualcomm Technologies, and R&S used the R&S CMX500 as an AI-enabled base station emulator to demonstrate AI-enhanced CSI feedback with a claimed ~50% downlink throughput increase versus conventional non-AI technology.[55] | The source says the controlled testing environment of the CMX500 is important for accurately evaluating AI-based algorithms under realistic radio conditions.[57] | The vault says the source does not provide full measurement methodology, test conditions, reproducibility data, or whether the AI-enabled base-station-emulator mode is orderable, prototype, or demo-only.[56] |
| AI-assisted CMX500 test scripting and workflow automation | Signaling tester workflow | The CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant is described as an AI-powered tool for the R&S CMX500 5G one-box signaling tester that uses generative AI and NLP to automate test script generation and functional testing.[8] | The tool is said to generate XLAPI scripts with significantly less time and effort, extend existing scripts, explain scripts, and support R&D 5G NR protocol testing, application testing, and CMX instrument automation.[8][46] | The vault says deployment options, license, version, data governance, supported CMX software release, and whether it equals ScriptAssist or AI Workplace are not specified.[48][69] |
| AI server high-speed PCB / channel / cable / connector testing | Non-signaling electrical test | The AI server ecosystem mapping lists ZNA / ZNB for PCB IL and TDR, ZNA for PCBA high-speed trace testing, and ZNA / ZNB + OSP for high-speed cable testing.[63][64] | The same source frames AI server PCB needs around 20+ layer UBB, high-end ABF, low-Dk CCL, and GB200 / NVL72-driven increases in layer count and material grade.[6] | The mapping is only an Excel-derived sales / solution lead and does not provide formal setup, option, fixture, frequency, or calibration conditions.[2][61] |
| AI server clock, jitter, phase-noise, and LDO noise testing | Non-signaling RF / signal-quality test | The AI server mapping lists FSWP for server motherboard LDO NSD and clock jitter testing, and for network switch jitter / phase-noise testing.[62] | The network-switch row maps FSWP jitter / phase-noise test, ZNA / ZNB VNA, and EMI pretest to the AI server ecosystem mapping.[64] | The mapping does not provide measurement conditions or formal product configuration.[61][64] |
| AI server power rail, multiphase DC, PI, PDN, and BMS-related testing | Non-signaling power / PI test | The server motherboard / PCBA row maps ZNL to PDN Target Z, MXO to power rail / multiphase DC / PI, ZISO, FSWP to LDO NSD / clock jitter, and ZNA to high-speed trace testing.[6][64] | The power-supply row lists HVDC, 5–10 kW PSU, liquid-cooled power cabinet, and BBU as key components, and maps MXO, ZISO, FSWP LDO NSD test, and BMS test to the category.[6][64] | The source does not provide HVDC / PSU / BBU test configuration, option codes, firmware, fixture, or calibration conditions.[61][64] |
| AI server silicon photonics / CPO optical-electrical test | Non-signaling optical / VNA-based test | The silicon-photonics row maps optical VNA to ZNA / ZNB + PSA with ThinkLands and ZNA / ZNB + GOCA with Newkey.[65] | The same source says CPO raises active / passive SiPh, advanced packaging, and test demand, while also naming high-speed substrate and external laser-source roles in the SiPh / CPO context.[65] | These statements trace only to the AISeverEcosystem mapping and do not equal production, purchasing, shipment, or a formal R&S application note.[65] |
| Wi-Fi 7 production RF testing | Non-signaling RF tester, but not AI-specific in current evidence | The Wi-Fi 7 R&D / production page maps CMX500 to R&D signaling / interworking testing and CMP180 to production non-signaling RF testing.[17] | The CMP180 is described as optimized for WLAN production non-signaling RF measurements, supporting Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz, integrated two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing.[18] | The cited Wi‑Fi 7 production evidence is PR / demonstration positioning and does not directly connect CMP180 non-signaling production testing to AI applications or AI servers.[17][18][83] |
### Product / option alignment
| Product line | Can connect to need | Vault-confirmed option / specification | Why it is suitable in the evidence | Evidence | Gaps / quotation risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | Generative AI app UX testing, 6G AI radio validation, 5G NR signaling workflows | CMX500 order no. 1201.0002K70; R&S CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD.[74][77] | The AI UX testbed and 6G AI proof-of-concept both explicitly use CMX500 as the signaling / emulation platform.[49][55] | [49][55][74][77] | AI UX and 6G AI sources do not provide full option stack, software version, hardware configuration, measurement methodology, or orderable-feature status.[54][56] |
| CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant / ScriptAssist context | Faster scripting, XLAPI generation, protocol / application / instrument automation | CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant has no stated order number, license code, version, or deployment type in the vault; XLAPI is the Python-based CMX500 scripting interface and XLAPI installation package is CMX-KF600X.[12][48] | The assistant is explicitly described for CMX500 test script generation and functional testing, with R&D 5G NR protocol testing, application testing, and CMX automation as applications.[8][46] | [8][12][46][48] | The vault does not confirm whether CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant equals ScriptAssist, TechAssist, or AI Workplace, and does not provide security or data-governance details.[48][69][70] |
| ZNA / ZNB / OSP | AI server PCB IL / TDR, high-speed trace, high-speed cable, optical VNA / SiPh | The AI server mapping lists ZNA / ZNB for IL and TDR, ZNA for high-speed trace, and ZNA / ZNB + OSP for high-speed cable, but does not provide option codes or fixture conditions.[63][64] | The mapped needs align with AI server high-speed PCB, connector, cable, and SiPh / CPO test entries in the vault.[63][64][65] | [63][64][65] | The source is a sales mapping, not a formal datasheet, application note, configuration guide, or ordering guide.[2][61] |
| FSWP | AI server LDO NSD, clock jitter, jitter / phase-noise testing | The mapping lists FSWP for LDO NSD test, clock jitter test, and jitter / phase-noise test, but does not provide measurement conditions.[62] | The same mapping places FSWP in server motherboard, network switch, power supply, IC, and high-speed transmission contexts.[62][64] | [62][64] | No test limits, setup, frequency, firmware, option, or calibration details are provided.[61] |
| MXO / ZNL / ZISO | AI server PDN Target Z, power rail, multiphase DC, PI, motor-driver analysis, BMS-related entry | The mapping lists ZNL for PDN Target Z, MXO for power rail / multiphase DC / PI, ZISO, MXO for motor-driver analysis, and BMS test, but formal option details are not provided.[6][64] | These entries map directly to PCBA, power supply, and cooling-related AI server categories.[6][64] | [6][64] | ZISO, BMS test, option codes, firmware, fixtures, and test configurations are unresolved.[61] |
| CMP180 | Wi-Fi 7 production non-signaling RF testing | CMP180 supports Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz, two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for 2x2 MIMO testing.[18] | The vault positions CMP180 as the production non-signaling RF tester in the Wi-Fi 7 R&D / production solution split.[17][18] | [17][18] | The current evidence does not tie CMP180 production non-signaling RF testing to an AI-specific application, and the source is not a formal datasheet or configuration guide.[17][18][83] |
### Limits
Current evidence is stronger for CMX500 signaling opportunities in AI application / 6G demonstrations than for a non-signaling tester directly tied to AI applications, because the non-signaling AI evidence is mainly AI-server ecosystem sales mapping or Wi‑Fi 7 production positioning rather than AI application test demonstrations.[49][55][64][83]
The AI server solution mapping must not be treated as proof of customer adoption, customer priority, R&S customer relationship, formal configuration, or validated opportunity.[2][3]
The Wi‑Fi 7 CMP180 evidence supports non-signaling production RF testing, but the cited passages do not state an AI-specific use case for CMP180.[17][18][83]

- extend existing scripts；
- provide explanations for given scripts；

FWA CPE 市場與測試分類 › GSA FWA Device taxonomy（July 2025）
[[GSA-FWA-Company-Directory-V13.4]] 將 [[FWA Device]] 定義為包含 [[3GPP]] based modem、用於向住宅或企業建築提供 broadband connectivity 的任何裝置。

來源將 FWA Devices 分為兩個 families：

1. [[CPE]]：AC powered devices，設計為連續 24 hours broadband connectivity。
2. [[Battery operated devices]]：包含 batteries，設計用於 nomadic 或 sporadic broadband connectivity，例如 [[MiFi]] 或 [[Pocket Hotspot]]。

[[CPE]] family 進一步分為四種 product types：

| GSA product type | 來源定義 | 典型限制 |
|---|---|---|
| [[Indoor Sub 6GHz CPE]] / FR1 | 支援最高 6GHz 頻率的 4G 或 5G indoor AC powered FWA device | 來源未給個別產品完整 band / certification |
| [[Outdoor Sub 6GHz CPE]] / FR1 | 支援最高 6GHz 頻率的 4G 或 5G outdoor AC powered FWA device，通常透過 [[PoE]] | 來源未給 PoE 電氣規格或環境等級 |
| [[Indoor mmWave CPE]] / FR2 | 支援任一 mmWave frequency 的 5G indoor AC powered FWA device | 來源未逐項列出 FR2 band |
| [[Outdoor mmWave CPE]] / FR2 | 支援任一 mmWave frequency 的 5G outdoor AC powered FWA device，通常透過 [[PoE]] | 來源未逐項列出 antenna gain、IP rating 或 thermal limit |

額外第 5 種 product type 是 [[Battery Operated Hotspot]]，例如 [[MiFi]] 或 [[Mobile Hotspot]]。[[GSA-FWA-Company-Directory-V13.4]] 也明確排除 [[Smartphones]]、[[Industrial IoT Routers]]、沒有 integrated 3GPP antennas 的 devices、具備 [[Serial Interfaces]] 或 [[Edge Compute Capabilities]] 的 devices，以及 [[NB-IoT]]、[[Cat-M1]]、[[Cat-M2]]、[[Cat-1]] 等 narrowband devices。

⚠️ [[GSA-FWA-Company-Directory-V13.4]]（July 2025）說 FWA CPE taxonomy 是 CPE family 下的 Indoor / Outdoor Sub 6GHz、Indoor / Outdoor mmWave，加上 Battery Operated Hotspot，並排除 Industrial IoT Routers 與具 Edge Compute Capabilities 的 devices，但既有頁面 [[FWA CPE 市場與測試分類]]（來源未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）說企業級室內 uCPE / Wi-Fi 7 / Multi-Gig 是 FWA CPE 類型之一。判斷：兩者層級不同且來源目的不同；GSA taxonomy 較像 ecosystem directory 收錄規則，OneNote 表格較像產品 / 測試情境分類，暫並列保存，不自動合併。

[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 是 [[R&S AI Workplace Solutions]] 的 customer questionnaire，Latest Update 標示為 Wednesday, August 19, 2026，用於蒐集客戶在 virtual testing 與 AI-assisted, agentic test workflows 方面的需求、限制、工具整合與成功指標。

- 來源未說明 [[Virtual tester]] 是否為正式產品名、solution architecture 名稱或 sales / discovery 用語。

Virtual tester › 來源定義
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 的 short definitions 寫道：

> Virtual tester: an agentic workflow that spans implementation → test → debug → validation, not a single tool.

因此本庫把 [[Virtual tester]] 記為工作流 / solution concept，而非單一軟體工具或儀器。

Virtual tester › 可能涵蓋的流程
依問卷上下文，[[Virtual tester]] 相關需求可能涉及：

- test idea 到 running, [[Validated results]] 的流程理解；
- test script generation 或 refactoring；
- ambiguous logs / failure debugging；
- documentation lookup；
- end-to-end test execution；
- toolchain integration：repos、CI/CD、test frameworks、lab equipment interfaces、log / analysis pipelines；
- [[Orchestration layer]] 對 AI agents 的 rules、instructions、skills coordination。

以上是問卷問題範圍，不是已確認產品功能。

R&S AI Workplace › Customer discovery questionnaire 視角
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 補充 [[R&S AI Workplace]] 相關討論會先收集以下資訊：

- Current workflow and pain：從 new test idea 到 running, [[Validated results]] 的流程，以及 scripting、environment setup、debugging failures、documentation 等耗時點。
- AI and tooling readiness：是否已使用 AI coding assistants、IDE agents、CI bots 或 internal automation；並收集 data residency、air-gapped labs、cloud / LLM use approval 等政策限制。
- Integration and ecosystem：客戶的 instruments、software、CI、issue trackers，以及 [[Orchestration layer]] 要 plug in 的位置。
- Point tools vs [[Virtual tester]]：客戶是需要 better scripting / log analysis 等 point tools，或需要跨 implementation → test → debug → validation 的 broader [[Virtual tester]]。
- Outcomes：time to first test、mean time to debug、regression coverage、reuse of tests、fewer expert escalations。
- Risk and adoption：technical、organizational、compliance blockers，以及需要 vendor 提供 training、reference architectures、security documentation 或 pilot support。
- Tools & AI harness：[[Claude Code]]、[[Cursor]] 或 similar tools、license / approval flow、guardrails、integration with repos / CI/CD / test frameworks / lab equipment interfaces / log pipelines，以及 [[Customer agent harness]] 優先 orchestration 的任務。

R&S AI Workplace › 定義與範圍
兩份 prerequisites 來源都將 Base AI Workplace 標示為 always needed for all AIW Assists，並把 [[ScriptAssist]] 與 [[TechAssist]] 的前置需求建立在這一組 base requirements 之上。來源未定義 AIW Assists 的完整產品清單，也未說明 [[R&S AI Workplace]] 的部署架構、license 型號或功能範圍。

[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 則不是 prerequisites，而是問卷。它用於了解客戶 around virtual testing and AI-assisted, agentic test workflows 的 needs and constraints，包含如何 create tests、analyze results、integrate tools into engineering environment。

Current evidence is stronger for CMX500 signaling opportunities in AI application / 6G demonstrations than for a non-signaling tester directly tied to AI applications, because the non-signaling AI evidence is mainly AI-server ecosystem sales mapping or Wi‑Fi 7 production positioning rather than AI application test demonstrations.[49][55][64][83]

- extend existing scripts；

FWA CPE 市場與測試分類 › GSA FWA Device taxonomy（July 2025）
[[GSA-FWA-Company-Directory-V13.4]] 將 [[FWA Device]] 定義為包含 [[3GPP]] based modem、用於向住宅或企業建築提供 broadband connectivity 的任何裝置。

來源將 FWA Devices 分為兩個 families：

1. [[CPE]]：AC powered devices，設計為連續 24 hours broadband connectivity。
2. [[Battery operated devices]]：包含 batteries，設計用於 nomadic 或 sporadic broadband connectivity，例如 [[MiFi]] 或 [[Pocket Hotspot]]。

[[CPE]] family 進一步分為四種 product types：

| GSA product type | 來源定義 | 典型限制 |
|---|---|---|
| [[Indoor Sub 6GHz CPE]] / FR1 | 支援最高 6GHz 頻率的 4G 或 5G indoor AC powered FWA device | 來源未給個別產品完整 band / certification |
| [[Outdoor Sub 6GHz CPE]] / FR1 | 支援最高 6GHz 頻率的 4G 或 5G outdoor AC powered FWA device，通常透過 [[PoE]] | 來源未給 PoE 電氣規格或環境等級 |
| [[Indoor mmWave CPE]] / FR2 | 支援任一 mmWave frequency 的 5G indoor AC powered FWA device | 來源未逐項列出 FR2 band |
| [[Outdoor mmWave CPE]] / FR2 | 支援任一 mmWave frequency 的 5G outdoor AC powered FWA device，通常透過 [[PoE]] | 來源未逐項列出 antenna gain、IP rating 或 thermal limit |

額外第 5 種 product type 是 [[Battery Operated Hotspot]]，例如 [[MiFi]] 或 [[Mobile Hotspot]]。[[GSA-FWA-Company-Directory-V13.4]] 也明確排除 [[Smartphones]]、[[Industrial IoT Routers]]、沒有 integrated 3GPP antennas 的 devices、具備 [[Serial Interfaces]] 或 [[Edge Compute Capabilities]] 的 devices，以及 [[NB-IoT]]、[[Cat-M1]]、[[Cat-M2]]、[[Cat-1]] 等 narrowband devices。

⚠️ [[GSA-FWA-Company-Directory-V13.4]]（July 2025）說 FWA CPE taxonomy 是 CPE family 下的 Indoor / Outdoor Sub 6GHz、Indoor / Outdoor mmWave，加上 Battery Operated Hotspot，並排除 Industrial IoT Routers 與具 Edge Compute Capabilities 的 devices，但既有頁面 [[FWA CPE 市場與測試分類]]（來源未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）說企業級室內 uCPE / Wi-Fi 7 / Multi-Gig 是 FWA CPE 類型之一。判斷：兩者層級不同且來源目的不同；GSA taxonomy 較像 ecosystem directory 收錄規則，OneNote 表格較像產品 / 測試情境分類，暫並列保存，不自動合併。

Generative AI user experience testing › 測試目的

本來源中的 testbed 目標是：

- 在 diverse wireless environments 下量化 end-user experience。

- 支援 on-device generative AI application design optimization。
- 為 future network optimization 提供 reference points。
- 支援 [[6G-enabled AI technologies]] 的 evolution、validation and standardization。

| 6G / AI-enhanced radio algorithm validation | Signaling / base-station emulation | KT, Qualcomm Technologies, and R&S used the R&S CMX500 as an AI-enabled base station emulator to demonstrate AI-enhanced CSI feedback with a claimed ~50% downlink throughput increase versus conventional non-AI technology.[55] | The source says the controlled testing environment of the CMX500 is important for accurately evaluating AI-based algorithms under realistic radio conditions.[57] | The vault says the source does not provide full measurement methodology, test conditions, reproducibility data, or whether the AI-enabled base-station-emulator mode is orderable, prototype, or demo-only.[56] |
| AI-assisted CMX500 test scripting and workflow automation | Signaling tester workflow | The CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant is described as an AI-powered tool for the R&S CMX500 5G one-box signaling tester that uses generative AI and NLP to automate test script generation and functional testing.[8] | The tool is said to generate XLAPI scripts with significantly less time and effort, extend existing scripts, explain scripts, and support R&D 5G NR protocol testing, application testing, and CMX instrument automation.[8][46] | The vault says deployment options, license, version, data governance, supported CMX software release, and whether it equals ScriptAssist or AI Workplace are not specified.[48][69] |

| AI server clock, jitter, phase-noise, and LDO noise testing | Non-signaling RF / signal-quality test | The AI server mapping lists FSWP for server motherboard LDO NSD and clock jitter testing, and for network switch jitter / phase-noise testing.[62] | The network-switch row maps FSWP jitter / phase-noise test, ZNA / ZNB VNA, and EMI pretest to the AI server ecosystem mapping.[64] | The mapping does not provide measurement conditions or formal product configuration.[61][64] |
| AI server power rail, multiphase DC, PI, PDN, and BMS-related testing | Non-signaling power / PI test | The server motherboard / PCBA row maps ZNL to PDN Target Z, MXO to power rail / multiphase DC / PI, ZISO, FSWP to LDO NSD / clock jitter, and ZNA to high-speed trace testing.[6][64] | The power-supply row lists HVDC, 5–10 kW PSU, liquid-cooled power cabinet, and BBU as key components, and maps MXO, ZISO, FSWP LDO NSD test, and BMS test to the category.[6][64] | The source does not provide HVDC / PSU / BBU test configuration, option codes, firmware, fixture, or calibration conditions.[61][64] |
| AI server silicon photonics / CPO optical-electrical test | Non-signaling optical / VNA-based test | The silicon-photonics row maps optical VNA to ZNA / ZNB + PSA with ThinkLands and ZNA / ZNB + GOCA with Newkey.[65] | The same source says CPO raises active / passive SiPh, advanced packaging, and test demand, while also naming high-speed substrate and external laser-source roles in the SiPh / CPO context.[65] | These statements trace only to the AISeverEcosystem mapping and do not equal production, purchasing, shipment, or a formal R&S application note.[65] |
| Wi-Fi 7 production RF testing | Non-signaling RF tester, but not AI-specific in current evidence | The Wi-Fi 7 R&D / production page maps CMX500 to R&D signaling / interworking testing and CMP180 to production non-signaling RF testing.[17] | The CMP180 is described as optimized for WLAN production non-signaling RF measurements, supporting Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz, integrated two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing.[18] | The cited Wi‑Fi 7 production evidence is PR / demonstration positioning and does not directly connect CMP180 non-signaling production testing to AI applications or AI servers.[17][18][83] |
### Product / option alignment
| Product line | Can connect to need | Vault-confirmed option / specification | Why it is suitable in the evidence | Evidence | Gaps / quotation risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | Generative AI app UX testing, 6G AI radio validation, 5G NR signaling workflows | CMX500 order no. 1201.0002K70; R&S CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD.[74][77] | The AI UX testbed and 6G AI proof-of-concept both explicitly use CMX500 as the signaling / emulation platform.[49][55] | [49][55][74][77] | AI UX and 6G AI sources do not provide full option stack, software version, hardware configuration, measurement methodology, or orderable-feature status.[54][56] |
| CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant / ScriptAssist context | Faster scripting, XLAPI generation, protocol / application / instrument automation | CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant has no stated order number, license code, version, or deployment type in the vault; XLAPI is the Python-based CMX500 scripting interface and XLAPI installation package is CMX-KF600X.[12][48] | The assistant is explicitly described for CMX500 test script generation and functional testing, with R&D 5G NR protocol testing, application testing, and CMX automation as applications.[8][46] | [8][12][46][48] | The vault does not confirm whether CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant equals ScriptAssist, TechAssist, or AI Workplace, and does not provide security or data-governance details.[48][69][70] |

| FSWP | AI server LDO NSD, clock jitter, jitter / phase-noise testing | The mapping lists FSWP for LDO NSD test, clock jitter test, and jitter / phase-noise test, but does not provide measurement conditions.[62] | The same mapping places FSWP in server motherboard, network switch, power supply, IC, and high-speed transmission contexts.[62][64] | [62][64] | No test limits, setup, frequency, firmware, option, or calibration details are provided.[61] |
| MXO / ZNL / ZISO | AI server PDN Target Z, power rail, multiphase DC, PI, motor-driver analysis, BMS-related entry | The mapping lists ZNL for PDN Target Z, MXO for power rail / multiphase DC / PI, ZISO, MXO for motor-driver analysis, and BMS test, but formal option details are not provided.[6][64] | These entries map directly to PCBA, power supply, and cooling-related AI server categories.[6][64] | [6][64] | ZISO, BMS test, option codes, firmware, fixtures, and test configurations are unresolved.[61] |
| CMP180 | Wi-Fi 7 production non-signaling RF testing | CMP180 supports Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz, two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for 2x2 MIMO testing.[18] | The vault positions CMP180 as the production non-signaling RF tester in the Wi-Fi 7 R&D / production solution split.[17][18] | [17][18] | The current evidence does not tie CMP180 production non-signaling RF testing to an AI-specific application, and the source is not a formal datasheet or configuration guide.[17][18][83] |
### Limits
Current evidence is stronger for CMX500 signaling opportunities in AI application / 6G demonstrations than for a non-signaling tester directly tied to AI applications, because the non-signaling AI evidence is mainly AI-server ecosystem sales mapping or Wi‑Fi 7 production positioning rather than AI application test demonstrations.[49][55][64][83]
The AI server solution mapping must not be treated as proof of customer adoption, customer priority, R&S customer relationship, formal configuration, or validated opportunity.[2][3]
The Wi‑Fi 7 CMP180 evidence supports non-signaling production RF testing, but the cited passages do not state an AI-specific use case for CMP180.[17][18][83]

[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant from Rohde & Schwarz facilitates mobile device testing through AI-driven automation]] 提供一個更具體的 AI-assisted test workflow 例子：[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 被描述為用於 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G one-box signaling tester 的 AI-powered tool，利用 generative AI 與 natural language processing 協助 test engineers automate test script generation and functional testing。

此來源中的 workflow pain 是 mobile device manufacturers 的 test engineers 在時間壓力下，需從 [[3GPP specifications]]、[[XLAPI]] scripts、[[Python]] 與 [[R&S CMX500]] user manual 等多種來源手動彙整 script inputs。工具宣稱可：

- generate accurate [[XLAPI]] scripts with significantly less time and effort；
- extend existing scripts；
- provide explanations for given scripts；
- 支援 R&D [[5G NR]] protocol testing、application testing 與 CMX instrument automation。

使用限制：該 PR 未說明 [[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 是否屬於 [[R&S AI Workplace]]、[[ScriptAssist]] 或 [[TechAssist]]；因此只能把它視為 CMX500-specific AI scripting assistant 例子，不可自動合併到既有 AIW on-prem product 頁。

Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[China Mobile Research Institute]] 在 [[MWC Shanghai 2026]] 展示一套 generative AI applications 測試 solution。
- 來源稱此 solution based on the [[R&S CMX500]] 5G one-box signaling tester，可在 diverse network conditions 下首次量化 measurement end-user experience of generative AI applications。
- 測試架構中：
  - [[Large language model]] 部署在 server side 或 cloud。
  - [[R&S CMX500]] 與執行 client-side test application 的 smart terminal 建立 radio connection。
  - [[R&S CMX500]] 可配置 network parameters、channel fading models、latency、jitter、RF impairments 等 variables。
  - 使用者透過 terminal-side application 輸入 prompts，接收 LLM inference responses。
  - Host PC software 收集與分析 data，並產生 charts。
- 來源列出的 key performance indicators 包含 [[Time to First Token]]（TTFT）與 [[Tokens Per Second]]（TPS）。
- 來源稱此方法可支援 optimization of on-device generative AI application design，並提供 future network optimization 的 reference points。
- 來源把 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 all-in-one test platform，支援 SA / NSA architectures、FR1 to FR3（up to 18 GHz）、built-in IMS server、RF conformance、protocol validation、VoNR acoustics 與 carrier aggregation。
- [[Liu Guangyi]] 的引述把此 testbed 連到 6G-enabled ubiquitous intelligent connectivity、native network computing capabilities、new AI service metrics 與 testing methodologies。
- [[Jin Hailiang]] 的引述把此 testbed 描述為 generative AI user experience testing 的 benchmark，並指向 future test scenarios、industry use cases 與 standardization。
- 展示地點：China Mobile’s 6G Zone，Hall 3，N3E60。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
